item.title: U.S. intercepts Iranian attacks on 3 ships. And, what to know about hantavirus
item.description: The U.S. says it intercepted Iranian attacks yesterday targeting three Navy ships. And, what to know about the hantavirus outbreak that started on a cruise ship.

item.title: The U.S. fires on Iranian tankers trying to evade its blockade amid a Hormuz standoff
item.description: U.S. forces fired on two Iranian oil tankers after exchanging fire with Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz overnight. And the United Arab Emirates reported another Iranian missile and drone attack.

item.title: UFO files spanning decades are released by Defense Department
item.description: Cold War reports of mysterious rotating saucers; recent sightings of metallic elliptical objects floating in mid-air. Those and other reports of unidentified anomalous phenomena or UAPs — the military's term for UFOs — are described in documents released Friday.
